Hi Tauhid,

I’m sorry, but the CC-TEE-WHITE in size S is currently out of stock. We have a restock order drafted, but it has not been sent yet, so we can’t confirm a delivery date at this time.

If you’re able to wait, we can keep your order open and update you when we have a confirmed restock timeline. If you’d consider another size, let us know and we can check its availability before making any changes.

Thanks for your understanding,
Campus Customs
